docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Caroline Ridding’s English translation of Bāṇa’s seventh-century Sanskrit prose romance the Kādambarī, with its continuation by his son Bhūṣaṇabhaṭṭa (London, 1896). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Kadambari of Bana · Bana, Kadambari, Ridding, Caroline Mary, Bhushana-Bhatta, son of Bana · 1896, 272 scanned pages. Published 1896; Caroline Mary Ridding died 1941; Bāṇa and Bhūṣaṇabhaṭṭa are early medieval; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
